2014_feats.aberrant-dragonmark.descripti:
Your exposure to the alien influence of the Far Realm or the planes has manifested a magical mark. You gain the following benefits:
- Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You learn one cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer spell list. In addition, choose one 1st-level spell from the sorcerer spell list. You learn that spell and can cast it at its lowest level. Once you cast it, you must finish a long rest before you can cast it again using this feature. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
- Your dragonmark has grown in size and power. When you gain a level, you can replace the cantrip you learned from this feat with another cantrip from the sorcerer spell list.
2014_feats.aberrant-dragonmark.summary: Gain a 1st-level spell from a class and a damage resistance

2014_feats.actor.description:
Skilled at mimicry and dramatics, you gain the following benefits:
- Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You have advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks when trying to pass yourself off as a different person.
- You can mimic the speech of another person or the sounds made by other creatures. You must have heard the person speaking, or heard the creature make the sound, for at least 1 minute. A successful Wisdom (Insight) check contested by your Charisma (Deception) check allows a listener to determine that the effect is faked.
2014_feats.actor.summary: Advantage on Deception/Performance when impersonating, +1 CHA, mimic speech
2014_feats.alert.description:

- You can't be surprised while you are conscious.
- You gain a +5 bonus to initiative.
- Other creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls against you as a result of being hidden from you.

2014_feats.athlete.description:
You have undergone extensive physical training to gain the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- When you are prone, standing up uses only 5 feet of your movement.
- Climbing doesn't halve your speed.
- You can make a running jump or a running high jump after moving only 5 feet on foot, rather than 10 feet.
2014_feats.athlete.summary: Climb/Swim/Speed increase; ignore climbing movement cost
2014_feats.blade-master.description:
You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, gaining the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You gain proficiency with four simple or martial weapons of your choice. Each chosen weapon must have a different proficiency category (simple or martial) than the others, unless you already have proficiency with all simple and martial weapons.
- Whenever you roll a 1 on a damage die for an attack you make with a weapon, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1.
2014_feats.blade-master.summary: Critical hits on 19-20 with one weapon type

The ally must use the new roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

2014_feats.charger.description:
When you use your action to Dash, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack or to shove a creature.
If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line immediately before taking this bonus action, you either gain a +5 bonus to the attack's damage roll (if you choose and hit with a melee weapon attack) or push the target 10 feet away from you (if you choose to shove and succeed).
2014_feats.charger.summary: Dash and attack or shove for bonus damage
2014_feats.critter.description:
Your affinity with beasts and the natural world has granted you the ability to communicate with creatures. You gain the following benefits:
- Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You learn the druidcraft cantrip.
- You can cast the speak with animals spell at will, without expending a spell slot.
2014_feats.critter.summary: +1 Wisdom (max 20). Learn druidcraft cantrip. Cast speak with animals at will without expending a spell slot.

- You ignore the loading quality of crossbows with which you are proficient.
- Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
- When you use the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a hand crossbow you are holding.

2014_feats.diplomat.description:
You are a skilled negotiator, gaining the following benefits:
- Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You gain proficiency in the Persuasion skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you gain expertise with it, which means your proficiency bonus is doubled for any check you make with it.
- If you spend 1 minute talking to someone who can understand you, you can make a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by the creature's Wisdom (Insight) check. If you or your companions are fighting a creature, you have disadvantage on the check. If you succeed on the check, the creature is charmed by you for 1 hour. If you fail, the creature can't be charmed by you for 24 hours.
2014_feats.diplomat.summary: Advantage on Charisma checks when interacting with groups
2014_feats.divinely-favored.description:
You have been touched by a divine power, gaining the following benefits:
- Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You learn one cantrip of your choice from the cleric spell list.
- You learn one 1st-level spell of your choice from the cleric spell list. You can cast this spell at its lowest level without expending a spell slot. Once you cast it this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
2014_feats.divinely-favored.summary: +1 Wisdom or Charisma (max 20). Learn one cleric cantrip and one 1st-level cleric spell. Cast the 1st-level spell once per long rest without expending a spell slot.
2014_feats.dragon-fear.description: When you make a successful melee attack against a creature, you can replace the damage with a breath weapon. When you do so, each creature of your choice in a 30-foot cone must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier). On a failed save, a creature is frightened of you for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature isn't frightened. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
2014_feats.dragon-fear.summary: Breath weapon; use action to frighten nearby creatures
2014_feats.dragon-fear-2.description:
When you unleash your draconic heritage, your enemies quake with fear, granting you the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- Instead of exhaling destructive energy, you can roar and expend a use of your Breath Weapon to force each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier). A creature that fails is frightened of you until the end of your next turn. A creature that succeeds is immune to this effect for 24 hours.
2014_feats.dragon-fear-2.summary: Breath weapon; use action to frighten nearby creatures
2014_feats.dragon-hide.description: You manifest scales and claws reminiscent of your draconic ancestors. While you aren't wearing any armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit. In addition, your scales give you resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.
2014_feats.dragon-hide.summary: Natural armor; retract claws for natural weapons
2014_feats.dragon-hide-2.description:
You manifest scales and claws similar to those of a dragon. You gain the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength, Constitution, or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- Your scales harden. While you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.
- You grow retractable claws from the tips of your fingers. Extending or retracting the claws requires no action. The claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes with. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the normal bludgeoning damage for an unarmed strike.
2014_feats.dragon-hide-2.summary: Natural armor; retract claws for natural weapons
2014_feats.drow-high-magic.description: You learn the detect magic spell and can cast it at will, without expending a spell slot. 2014_feats.dual-wielder.description:
You master fighting with two weapons, gaining the following benefits:
- You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you are wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand.
- You can use two-weapon fighting even when the one-handed melee weapons you aren't wielding aren't light.
- You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.
2014_feats.dual-wielder.summary: Two-weapon fighting without light weapons; +1 AC
2014_feats.dungeon-delver.description:
Alert to the hidden traps and secret doors found in many dungeons, you gain the following benefits:
- You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to detect the presence of secret doors.
- You have advantage on saving throws made to resist or avoid traps.
- You have resistance to the damage dealt by traps.
- You can search for traps while traveling at a normal pace instead of a slow pace.
2014_feats.dungeon-delver.summary: Advantage on perception for traps; resist trap damage

- Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum number of hit points you regain from the roll equals twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).
2014_feats.durable.summary: +1 Constitution (max 20). When rolling Hit Dice to regain HP, the minimum you regain is twice your Constitution modifier (minimum 2).
2014_feats.dwarven-fortitude.description: Whenever you take the Dodge action in combat, you can spend one Hit Die to heal yourself. Roll the die, add your Constitution modifier, and regain a number of hit points equal to the total (minimum of 1).

2014_feats.eldritch-adept.description:
Studying occult lore, you have unlocked eldritch magic that can be learned only by those who know the Arcana of the Mysteries. You gain the following benefits:
- You learn one Eldritch Invocation option of your choice from the warlock class. If the invocation has a prerequisite, you can choose that invocation only if you're a warlock who meets the prerequisite. 2014_feats.elemental-adept.description:

Spells you cast ignore resistance to the damage type you chose. In addition, when you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.
You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different damage type.

Immediately after taking damage, you can use your reaction to magically become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or force someone to make a saving throw. Once you use this feat, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
2014_feats.fade-away.summary: When damaged, can turn invisible as reaction until next turn

You remain invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or force someone to make a saving throw. 2014_feats.fell-thrower.description: You have perfected the technique of throwing your weapon at an enemy, granting you the following benefits: • Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. • When you hit a creature with a ranged attack using a thrown weapon, you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with the same weapon against the same target. This grapple is possible only if the target is no more than one size larger than you and if you have a hand free to grab it.
2014_feats.fell-thrower.summary: Throw a weapon with extra damage; it returns
2014_feats.fey-teleportation.description: Your study of high elven lore has unlocked fey power that few other elves possess, except your kin in the eladrin. Drawing on your fey ancestry, you can cast the misty step spell at will, without expending a spell slot or material components. You also learn one of the following languages of your choice: Sylvan, Elvish, or both. When you use this feat to cast misty step, you can also speak the password to teleport to a location you've previously visited. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
2014_feats.fey-teleportation.summary: Cast misty step once per short rest; learn one language

You can also spend one luck point when an attack roll is made against you. Roll a d20, and then choose whether the attack uses the attacker's roll or yours.
If more than one creature spends a luck point to influence the outcome of a roll, the points cancel each other out; no additional dice are rolled.
You regain your expended luck points when you finish a long rest.

2014_feats.ritual-caster.description:
You have learned a number of spells that you can cast as rituals. These spells are written in a ritual book, which you must have in hand while casting one of them.
When you choose this feat, you acquire a ritual book holding two 1st-level spells of your choice. Choose one of the following classes: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard. You must choose your spells from that class's spell list, and the spells you choose must have the ritual tag. The class you choose also determines your spellcasting ability for these spells: Charisma for bard, sorcerer, or warlock; Wisdom for cleric or druid; Intelligence for wizard.
If you come across a spell in written form, such as a magical spell scroll or a wizard's spellbook, you might be able to add it to your ritual book. The spell must be on the spell list for the class you chose, the spell's level can be no higher than half your level (rounded up), and adding it requires time and gold equal to twice the spell's level.
2014_feats.ritual-caster.summary: Choose a spellcasting class. Acquire a ritual book with two 1st-level ritual spells of your choice from that class. Cast them as rituals without preparing them first.
2014_feats.savage-attacker.description: Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can reroll the weapon's damage dice and must use the new roll.

2014_feats.second-chance.description: Fortune favors you when you least expect it. When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can reroll the die. You must use the new roll, even if it is also a 1. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
2014_feats.second-chance.summary: When hit, force attacker to reroll as reaction
2014_feats.second-chance-2.description:

- Increase your Dexterity, Constitution, or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to force that creature to reroll. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you roll initiative at the start of combat or until you finish a short or long rest.

2014_feats.sentinel.description:
You have mastered techniques to take advantage of every drop in any enemy's guard, gaining the following benefits:
- When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, the creature's speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.
- Creatures within 5 feet of you provoke opportunity attacks from you even if they take the Disengage action before leaving your reach.
- When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against a target other than you (or no target), you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against the attacking creature.
2014_feats.sentinel.summary: Reduce target speed to 0; opportunity attacks even if they disengage
2014_feats.shadow-touched.description:
Your exposure to the Shadowfell's magic has changed you, granting you the following benefits:
- Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You learn the invisibility spell and one 1st-level spell of your choice from the illusion or necromancy school of magic. The 1st-level spell must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the spellcaster table. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot once until you finish a long rest. You can also cast the spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.
2014_feats.shadow-touched.summary: Learn invisibility and one spell; cast once per long rest
2014_feats.sharpshooter.description:
You have mastered ranged weapons and can make shots that others find impossible. You gain the following benefits:
- Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls.
- Your ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover.
- Before you make an attack with a ranged weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.
2014_feats.sharpshooter.summary: Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on ranged weapon attack rolls. Your ranged weapon attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover. Before making a ranged attack with a weapon you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll to deal +10 damage.
2014_feats.shield-master.description:
You use shields not just for protection, but also for offense. You gain the following benefits:
- If you take the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to try to shove a creature within 5 feet of you with your shield.
- If you aren't incapacitated, you can add your shield's AC bonus to any Dexterity saving throw you make against a spell or other harmful effect that targets only you.
- If you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can use your reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, interposing your shield between yourself and the source of the effect.
2014_feats.shield-master.summary: Add shield bonus to Dex saves; shove as bonus action

You are expert at slinking through the shadows. You gain the following benefits:
- You can try to hide when you are lightly obscured from the creature from which you are hiding.
- When you are hidden from a creature and miss it with a ranged attack, making the attack doesn't reveal your position.
- Dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.
2014_feats.skulker.summary: Hide in dim light; can hide after missing with ranged attack
2014_feats.slasher.description:
You are trained in the art of cutting and slashing your enemies, granting you the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack that deals slashing damage, you can reduce the target's speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
- When you score a critical hit with an attack that deals slashing damage, you grievously wound the target. Until the start of your next turn, the target has disadvantage on all attack rolls.
2014_feats.slasher.summary: Reduce target speed on hit; critical on 19-20 with one weapon type

2014_feats.svirfneblin-magic.description: You have inherited the innate spellcasting ability of your ancestors. This ability allows you to cast nondetection on yourself at will, without needing a material component. You can also cast each of the following spells once with this ability: blindness/deafness, blur, and disguise self. You regain the ability to cast these spells with this ability when you finish a long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
2014_feats.svirfneblin-magic.summary: Cast spells once per long rest; advantage on saves vs illusions
2014_feats.tavern-brawler.description:
Accustomed to rough-and-tumble fighting using whatever comes to hand, you gain the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You are proficient with improvised weapons.
- Your unarmed strike uses a d4 for damage.
- When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or an improvised weapon on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to grapple the target.
2014_feats.tavern-brawler.summary: Improvised weapons deal 1d4 damage; can grapple as bonus action
2014_feats.tough.description: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit points.
2014_feats.tough.summary: Your hit point maximum increases by twice your level when you gain this feat. Each time you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2.
2014_feats.war-caster.description:
You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits:
- You have advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your concentration on a spell when you take damage.
- You can perform the somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a shield in one or both hands.
- When a hostile creature's movement provokes an opportunity attack from you, you can use your reaction to cast a spell at the creature, rather than making an opportunity attack. The spell must have a casting time of 1 action and must target only the creature.
2014_feats.war-caster.summary: Advantage on concentration saves; cast spells as opportunity attacks
2014_feats.weapon-master.description:
You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, gaining the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You gain proficiency with four simple or martial weapons of your choice.
2014_feats.weapon-master.summary: Proficiency with four weapons; +1 to one ability score
2014_feats.weapon-master-2.description:
You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, gaining the following benefits:
- Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
- You gain proficiency with four simple or martial weapons of your choice. Each chosen weapon must have a different proficiency category (simple or martial) than the others, unless you already have proficiency with all simple and martial weapons.
2014_feats.weapon-master-2.summary: Proficiency with four weapons; +1 to one ability score

2014_feats.wood-elf-magic.description: You learn the magic of the primeval woods, which are revered and protected by your people. You learn one cantrip of your choice from the druid spell list. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip. You also learn the longstrider and pass without trace spells, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast the spell in this way when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
2014_feats.wood-elf-magic.summary: Cast druidcraft and pass without trace spells
2014_feats.telekinetic.description:
You learn the mage hand cantrip. If you already know it, you learn a different cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list. You can use mage hand to move objects weighing up to 50 pounds.

Additionally, you can use a bonus action to telekinetically shove one creature or object within 30 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be moved 5 feet in a direction of your choice.
2014_feats.telekinetic.summary: Learn mage hand cantrip (50 lb capacity). Use bonus action to telekinetically shove a creature or object within 30 feet; target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be moved 5 feet.
